sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Arivu Education Loan Scheme," launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation, offers loans to students pursuing professional courses like MBBS, B.E., B.Tech., MBA, MCA, LLB, and others in various fields
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Loan

**Detailed Description:** The "Arivu Education Loan Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and is implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to provide loans to students who wish to pursue professional courses such as M.B.B.S., M.D., M.S., B.E., B.Tech., M.E., M.Tech., B.D.S., M.D.S., B.Ayush, M.Ayush, M.B.A., M.C.A., L.L.B., B.Arch, M.Arch, B.Sc. in Horticulture, Agriculture, Dairy Technology, Forestry, Veterinary, Animal Sciences, Food Technology, Biotechnology, Fisheries, Sericulture, Home/Community Sciences, Food Nutrition and Dietetics, B.Pharma, M.Pharma, Pharma.D, and D.Pharma.

**Benefits / Assistance:** > ***Loan Amount:*** - The loan amount is granted from ₹50,000/- to ₹5,00,000/- every year until the course duration.  > ***Loan Renewal Process:*** - Renewal and pay 12% of the loan amount issued by the corporation during the previous year at their respective District Office.  > **Loan Repayment:** - Repay the loan with service charges of 2% after 6 months of completion of the course.

**Application Process:** ***Application Process for Fresh Loan:*** Step-01: Applicant need to visits the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation [official website.](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/home) Step-02: Click "Apply Online&quot
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation; Nodal Department: Minorities Welfare Department
